build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball that must avoid an obstacle bar to reach the ground
create_task_with_define_task_template: create a parameterized task using define_task_template decorator with obstacle width, x, and y parameters
add_static_bar_obstacle: add a static bar obstacle to the PHYRE scene using C.add with set_left and set_bottom positioning
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with set_center_x and set_bottom positioning
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task goal by setting body1 and body2 with a TOUCHING spatial relationship
